Maya: Quick smoke test for the Optimize toolkit PR I just opened — need someone to sanity-check examples for batching/caching/quant profiles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Jon: I'll take a look, can you paste the minimal snippet that failed locally?
Maya: thx! snippet below — failing when sequence lengths vary a lot, cache toggle seems ignored
Maya: ```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
resp = client.generate(model='redwood/xxl', input='short prompt', batching={'max_batch_size': 8}, cache={'prefix_cache': True})
print(resp)
```
Liam: That looks fine. Are you running the new quant profile loader? if not, cache keys might differ
Maya: running with quant=v2 but using old json schema, hmm
Maya: I updated the PR with a note and a short migration snippet
Jon: I'll run a quick smoke in my env, maybe it's the SDK sample. If I reproduce I'll push a fix to the docs branch
Rachel: I can do a quick read-through of the examples and tech note for clarity this afternoon :+1:
doc-bot: CI build queued for docs PR #482 — build 92712
Jon: CI passed for lint but examples fail in integration tests — logs: https://ci.internal/92712/logs
Maya: thanks — attaching the failing test excerpt: `Cache miss on identical prefix when batching >1`
Liam: Prob cause: when batching is enabled we need to normalize input length before computing prefix hash. Quick fix: add pad_normalization to snippet
Liam: ```python
# add before calling generate
client.config.batch.pad_normalization = True
```
Maya: can you open a small docs PR with that snippet change? I'll reference it in the migration note
Jon: on it, will submit PR to the branch and ping here when ready
Jon: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/483 — updated snippet and added test
Rachel: reviewed, lgtm. minor wording tweak suggested on the migration note
Maya: applied Rachel's wording, updated the PR description
Maya: thanks everyone! re-running local smoke now
Maya: smoke looks good locally. I'll wait for the integration run then merge :rocket:
